msg: Hi, Here I will be detailing some advice on information about this game that you're about to play and tips that I hope will help you.When playing the game the gnomes are often paired up such as orange/brown, pink/green, red/yellow and blue/purple and some will lead  you into the dark forest whilst others will take you into the light forest. The aim is to collect as many mushrooms as this can change depending on the forest you end up in which you should focus on when it comes to the x5 round.Good luck with the game! I'm sure you'll do great best of luck
